Results.ReviewText: I couldn’t be happier with my first purchased charcoal grill! My previous Weber was gifted to me from my uncle and that grill had been a part of decades of wonderful memories. This upgraded version has many added perks and I couldn’t ask for anything more. It’s perfect for my needs and it helps with getting through shelter in place.
Results.Title: Perfect for me

Results.ReviewText: Parrila perfecta. Muy facil de armar los materiales son muy buenos. El tamaño esta perfecto para una familia de 4-6.
Results.Title: Master touch 22

Results.ReviewText: The best grill I ever used. The air flow management is really easy to use and to clean it after you use it is jut way too easy.
Results.Title: Amazing Grill

Results.ReviewText: Perfect product, delivery and service.  Absolutely a Weber man for life!
Results.Title: Love the Slate color

Results.ReviewText: The best grill ever!!! So much 2 do on it! Life is great.
Results.Title: The best

Results.ReviewText: Awesome grill. Love it, keeps hot for hours. Still trying to figure out how early to flip chicken.
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText: Love it it’s my first grill and I know I’ll have it for a long time. My only gripe is that I want to have more excuses to cook on it it everyday. So far in the last two months I have used it at least once a week.
Results.Title: First Time Owner: Guaranteed Lifetime Supporter

Results.ReviewText: Nice Color,  The only thing that could improve is the lid holder,  Use a plastic joint in the middle support area so that it doesn't scratch up the lid.  I have 3 Weber kettles.
Results.Title: Big Blue

Results.ReviewText: It’s a great little charcoal grill! The only negative would be the price. It’s a tad over priced for a small charcoal grill, hence the 4 star review. Other then that, it fits our needs for a couple.
Results.Title: Great little grill, but a tad pricey imo.

Results.ReviewText:
Love Weber Grills.

What I like:
1) They last forever
2) They allow you great control of the temperature with the vents.
3) Really like the cover lid holder.  Big improvement over built in hook that never worked.

What I Don't Like:
1) Gourmet BBQ cooking grate sucks.  I am not interested in adding any attachments.  The center grate always falls down whenever I attempt to clean it with the wire brush.  This has happened every single time.  It will fall into the hot coals and then I have to leave it there until the next time I BBQ.  I am ready to replace it with a standard weber grate.  Would be nice to have option not to get it with the order and save a little money.
Results.Title: NIce Features

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. My only complaint is that I cannot buy the new fire ring with steal plate for indirect cooking.
Results.Title: Great grill but want access to all accessories.

Results.ReviewText: Awesome grill and great looking.  Glad that I paid extra for the blue one since I will probably use for 20+ years.  Already smoked a brisket on it.
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: Timeless classic. High quality charcoal grill. Highly recommend
Results.Title: Masters touch

ClientResponses.Response: Hi. Thanks for taking the time to provide your feedback. We are glad to hear you love the grill. It is unfortunate the incorrect bowl was included but we were happy to send you a replacement. Please keep in mind your grill is backed by a generous warranty. If you ever have any other questions please reach out to us at support@weberstephen.com. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill, but when we purchased it and got home to put it together the bowl was for a different grill and did not have the predrilled holes for the lid holder.  Its a pricy for very little upgrades from the original kettle grill.
Results.Title: Pricey with wring parts.

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill. Above and beyond. All Features are amazing.
Results.Title: Great Purchase

Results.ReviewText: The lid thermometer and exhaust vent positions really make no sense. So just disregard that temperature gauge
Results.Title: Exhaust vent

Results.ReviewText: This is the ultimate grill. The kettle grill has remained unchanged for years and there’s a reason, cause it works. I use mine as a grill and smoker it works beautifully.
Results.Title: Best grill ever made

ClientResponses.Response: Hi, These grills are great to grill on. We are sorry you aren't having a great experience. Each country has different accessories they sell for this grill. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Not all the mods are available to North America. It’s an ok grill. It cooks like the 25 dollar grill so don’t waste your money on the 200 dollar one. It’s tippy. Psh unreal!
Results.Title: Don’t waste you dam money

Results.ReviewText: This is poetry in motion! The added features are worth the extra investment. I couldn’t be happier!
Results.Title: Love my upgraded Weber!

Results.ReviewText: Bien content du produit sauf pour la poignée du couvert qui a fondu.  On me l’a remplacé sans frais.  Très bon service après-vente.
Results.Title: Très polyvalent!

Photos.Caption: Looks like I know what I'm doing haha

Results.ReviewText: It's better than I thought, it's really a perfect grill.
Results.Title: Perfect grill

Results.ReviewText: Every family needs a Weber to cook on. Charcoal and lump coal will always beat a smoker and gas grill for taste and look.
Results.Title: Worth It!

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love this grill. Easy to put together shipped super fast and looks amazing
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText: This being my first weber grill. I'm mad. I'm mad at charbroil grills for selling me a cow dropping that rusted out after 3 and a half years of use. Everything about this grill is superior to my old one. I love it!
Results.Title: Best grill i have ever owned!! I'm a weber man now

Results.ReviewText: The ash collection bowl takes all the mess out of dealing with charcoal grilling. This upgraded grill is worth every cent!  That old familiar smell of the grill in the neighborhood brings back great memories and grilling with my family now, we’re creating new ones while we enjoy delicious grilled grub.
Results.Title: Upgrade your grill. You deserve it!

Results.ReviewText:
Outstanding grill I enjoy bbqing and smoking you can do both no limits 
With a Weber’s grill !!!
Results.Title: 22 inch Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic grill and the best service!!!  Love the size too, higher than my older 22.
Results.Title: Love the Slate MT!

Results.ReviewText: Wow! This guy lives up to the hype. I can see why you would never need another grill/smoker and why people collect these! This one is my 1st ever and it held temp amazingly. Make sure you have a good thermometer that has more than one probe so you don’t do what I did and over cook it a bit!
Results.Title: Makes your 1st smoke a breeze!

ClientResponses.Response: Hi, thanks for being a Weber fan and for your feedback! We are sorry to hear the trouble you have encountered with cleaning your new grill and with the GBS grates. Please reach out to us at support@weberstephen.com or 1-800-446-1071 and we would be happy to provide you some tips for using your new grill and to answer any additional questions you may have. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I find this grill an absolute pain to use:  Is a royal pain to clean inside, the grill grates do not seat evenly.  The center grate for the gourmet BBQ system sometimes falls into the coals when I attempt to do things like flip burgers or steaks.
Results.Title: Not impressed

Results.ReviewText: I love it. It’s exactly what I needed to add to my collection of Weber products.
Results.Title: My new Weber Kittle

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for any type of grilling or smoking. Accurate temp every time .
Results.Title: Great multi grill

Results.ReviewText: My 3rd kettle. Love the retaining pins on the legs that this grill has. Like the changes to the ash hopper retainer this one is easier to remove and replace than previous model. Suggest some kind of padding for the lid holder where it makes contact with lids porcelain. The center cooking grate can be tricky to keep positioned when doing a hot grate cleaning.  Overall like the improvements and hope to get the years of service out of this one that previous grills have provided
Results.Title: Mostly in love with it

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble and use. Great charcoal grill. Good value.
Results.Title: Charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: My wife and I both love it. The only drawback to this grill is the center ring of the grilling surface is awkward to handle; it would be much better if there was a way in which to secure it into the main grill surface. Perhaps a “twist and lock” design of some sort would work?
Results.Title: Only drawback.

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello! Thank you for being a long-time Weber fan. The enclosed ash-catcher assembly should not prevent your grill from reaching high temperatures conducive to grilling and searing. Here's a link to an article to an article with tips on getting your grill hot: https://www.weber.com/US/en/blog/burning-questions/why-wont-my-charcoal-grill-get-hot/weber-29952.html.
If you are still experiencing some issue after following these tips, please reach out to us at reviews@weberstephen.com. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had several 22” weber grills in the past. This new style master touch doesn’t seem to stay as hot for grilling/searing steaks with both top and bottom air vents open.  My guess is with the new ash catching design, it doesn’t have adequate air flow for glowing white hot coals?
Results.Title: Master Touch 22” grill

Results.ReviewText: The best and most versatile tool on the market for the price point
Results.Title: Happy and satisfied

Results.ReviewText: Je suis heureux de cette achat! Xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
Results.Title: Un vrai pour les vrais

Results.ReviewText: I seem to be missing the nut that holds the temp gauge on. I don’t think I lost it unpacking and assembling but that is the only complaint. Haven’t been able to use it yet but it seems nice.
Results.Title: Missing temp gauge nut.

Results.ReviewText:
Our purchase was well-timed, as our areas's power outage forced our maiden use.  Noted improvements over our 10+-yr.-old former model:  larger bowl, convenient rack for the lid, optional grates for Gourmet Bar-B-Q dishes, ash catcher, hood thermometer. 

Besides summer fun, this is our power-outage back-up, but the outside handle should be one piece instead of two, which makes for a flimsy grip for pulling the unit.
Results.Title: Vast Improvement on Original Model

Results.ReviewText:
These grills just keep on getting better - and last a long time.

I bought the Master-Touch to replace a grill that I purchased in 1983 - at this rate, I'll be passing this recent grill down to my grandchildren.

There is no better charcoal grill anywhere in the known universe - made in Illinois! (as a former flatlander, I really appreciate that)
Results.Title: This could be the last grill you ever need

Results.ReviewText: Beautiful bbq well built heavy metal used easy to put together.
Results.Title: Love my bbq

Results.ReviewText: If you're looking to upgrade over your old weber this weber is the next level. I do like the that the height of the grill is taller and the fact the sliding lid works well. The only issues the charcoal basket have sharp edges. But that being said i love the weber kettles diversity of cooking. I highly recommend this weber kettle.
Results.Title: NOT THE RUN OF THE MILL.

Results.ReviewText: A great grill that does it all. The price is perfect for someone looking into getting and learning how to use charcoal but also being able to smoke when you are ready.
Results.Title: Weber kettle

Results.ReviewText: Great grill! Had the Jumbo Joe for the fifth wheel already and love it so bought this for the back yard. the 22 inch and grill set up for ease of use is fantastic. Grilled 9 steaks and still had room for 9 more! Looking to add a rotisserie soon! the price to value is exceptional.
Results.Title: Great back yard grill!

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill.  Easy to use.  Looks great too. Excellent temperature control and big enough for direct and indirect cooking.
Results.Title: Better than hoped for

Results.ReviewText:
THE GRILL IS BUILT WITH GREAT QUALITY. IT WAS EASY TO ASSEMBLE, IN 15 MINUTES IT WAS ALREADY READY TO USE.
VERY PRACTICAL, WITH MANY DETAILS THAT ARE WORTH IT
Results.Title: GREAT GRILL!

Photos.Caption: Wings and steak for the Super Bowl

Results.ReviewText: It’s a great kettle grill. Smokes good really well. Tons of accessories for different types of cooking.
Results.Title: Master Touch.

Results.ReviewText: Simply awesome!, I'm in love with my Weber Grill. Perfect size and easy to clean.  I use it weekly.
Results.Title: Simply Awesome!

Results.ReviewText: It’s easy to recommend stepping up to a Master Touch from a Premium kettle grill.  The additional included upgrades would cost more than the approximately $50 higher price of a Master Touch.  That’s about $2 per year considering this Master Touch is replacing a 25-year-old kettle that finally broke down (weld on one leg snapped).
Results.Title: Master Touch = great value

Results.ReviewText: The grill arrived fast. The box was well made and my beautiful grill was perfect. Instructions are great and parts were complete. Don’t worry about shipping your grill will be fine! Thank you a Weber!!
Results.Title: I love my Weber!

Results.ReviewText: I love the removable center in the cooking grate and the fact that it’s so heavy. It came with some nice extras like a utensil holder and warming rack.Plus, it’s a pretty blue. So far, I’ve only used it once. Looking forward to a summer filled with grilling.
Results.Title: I love my new Weber grill

Photos.Caption: Weber needs to do better on the accessories prices

Results.ReviewText: Grates can be improved and better the quality. Cast iron is a great heat conductor, a grate handle, the quality of the bowl and lid are top notch a couple of extras or different ones is always a plus above all I do recommend this product.
Results.Title: Excellent product but can be improved.

Results.ReviewText: This is my second kettle. My first lasted 18 years. What else can I say? Gracias
Results.Title: The best pit ever for me...

Results.ReviewText: The Master-Touch Charcoal grill replaced a 22 year old Master Touch Grill that was starting to rust through in a couple of places.  New grill is a few inches taller which I like and has a warmer rack.  I did not like that the center section of the new grill grate comes out when you remove and hang the grate to light charcoal.  Thus I am using my old grill grate instead.
Results.Title: Master-Touch Charcoal 22" grill

Results.ReviewText: Awesome upgrade from my regular Kettle. Love the color too!
Results.Title: Master Touch 22” Slate Blue

Results.ReviewText: Bought this to replace my old 18 inch Weber. Wow what a upgrade. There is nothing I don’t like about it. The shipping was fast. Assembly was easy. The lid holder is a great feature. The blue finish looks awesome.
Results.Title: Great upgrade

Results.ReviewText: This is Weber no. 4 for me, 3 still works but it was time to upgrade. The patio is under 2 feet of snow so it's going to wait just a bit, but I know it will perform like all my others have.
Results.Title: Winter Blues

Results.ReviewText: Beautifully made grill. I use this grill almost everyday
Results.Title: Amazing

Results.ReviewText: This is my third kettle grill. Purchased for camping.
Results.Title: Master touch grill

Results.ReviewText: Built like a tank!  First steaks were fantastic. Looking forward to many years of great grilling.
Results.Title: Quality construction

Results.ReviewText:
I have recently undergone some lifestyle changes and my Webber is my stove. Together we make anything we could possibly make on a conventional gas stove. 
As long as Webber doesn’t go cheap on us with materials, I see no reason to ever switch.

When used properly, other than a big Ceramic thing which cost about five times that of a very nicely equipped Weber, you can’t go wrong with this grill Period I live within yards of the beach and this is my fourth grill in 20+ years.
Results.Title: There is simply no other

Results.ReviewText: We have owned Weber gas grills for years and loved them.  My husband wanted to add a charcoal grill.  We are very impressed with our addition.
Results.Title: Added charcoal

Results.ReviewText: Excellent quality, easy to use, making better meat than ever.
Results.Title: Great Purchase !

Results.ReviewText: Was damaged when bought but excellent customer service replace both damaged parts immediately
Results.Title: Excellent grill

Results.ReviewText:
This is a great grill it was easy to assemble 
Nice to cook on
Results.Title: Master touch grill

Results.ReviewText: Cooks great. Excellent quality grill.  Pretty Blue Color.  Temperature is very controllable...
Results.Title: Best grill I've ever owned.

14510601.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14510601.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
